# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Since this is an academic and reference Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) implementation project, security updates are applied to the main branch.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository (such as weak default keys, misconfigured X.509 profiles, or entropy issues), please report it responsibly by opening a private security advisory or contacting the maintainers directly. Do not open public issues for sensitive security vulnerabilities.
